stories.title: Iran has legitimate right to wield control over Strait of Hormuz — Vice President Aref
stories.summary: RABAT, August 25. It is Iran's sovereign right to manage and control the Strait of Hormuz, Iranian Vice President Mohammad Reza Aref said on Tuesday. "Iran's primacy and regulatory activity in the Strait of Hormuz is the legitimate and sovereign right of the Islamic Republic exercised over its national assets," Tasnim news agency quoted Aref as saying. On February 28, Iranian authorities announced that the US and Israel had struck an elementary school for girls in Minab. The strike killed 175 people, including 168 students, and wounded another 95. President Donald Trump later blamed Iran's armed forces for the attack while providing no evidence to back up this claim. Missile fragments recovered at the site later turned out to carry markings identifying them as American weapons. In a July 15 interview with Fox News, Trump said the findings of the US military's investigation into the strike will probably never be made public.
